name: dsh-deputy
description: Change-scored desktop sensing (4x4 contact sheet) + a real isolated Windows desktop you can actually operate in.

admin.reason: CreateDesktopW(GENERIC_ALL) 与 SetThreadDesktop 需要管理员权限；不足时插件显式报错，不降级到主桌面

screen.reason: BitBlt 采集隔离桌面画面

input.reason: SendInput 在隔离桌面内模拟键鼠

process.reason: 在隔离桌面内 CreateProcess 启动目标程序

network.reason: 面板数据面仅监听 127.0.0.1（不出网）；config.view.enabled=false 可关闭
